The fault is in **M2**: its gate is tied to its own drain (`M2 iout iout vss vss`) instead of to the reference node `iin`. The correct connection is `M2 iout iin vss vss`.

The operating points confirm this. M2's Vgs is 0.9 V, equal to its drain voltage, so it self-biases at about 160 µA instead of mirroring the 20 µA reference. Its output resistance is then just 1/gm ≈ 1/(5.52 × 160.7 µA) ≈ 1.13 kΩ, which matches the simulated 1119 Ω. The 703% error and the 0.9 V compliance follow from the same cause. M1 is a correctly diode-connected reference, and its 0% sensitivities are consistent with it not being the fault. The netlist has only two devices, so M1 is the only other candidate.
